title: Disability Awareness Month: Employment, Enrichment, and Inclusion.
bodyText: The month of October shall be known and designated as "Disability Awareness Month: Employment, Enrichment, and Inclusion." This month is not and shall not be construed as a state holiday.
bodyHtml: [§8-39]  Disability Awareness Month:  Employment, Enrichment, and Inclusion.  The month of October shall be known and designated as "Disability Awareness Month:  Employment, Enrichment, and Inclusion."  This month is not and shall not be construed as a state holiday. [L 2023, c 245, §2]
